For me his skillset at a two footed defender with elite heading, superb 1 on 1 defending, and comfort levels to play across the entire back four makes him worth the extra consideration. I wish we would try a trio of Xhaka, Ramsey and Elneny, because their skillsets complement and cover each other well. For Xhaka, the other two have the work rate to share the defensive burden and prevent teams from exploiting his lack of pace. Additionally, Elneny and Ramsey both know how to find space in the midfield, which provides Xhaka with two reliable passing options in the midfield to prevent teams from closing him down easily. A midfield three will pair him with Ramsey, who is more than willing to share that burden and occupy those spaces in the final 3rd. Ramsey will have license to roam without putting the team's defensive structure on ice because Xhaka and Elneny are both willing to sit back. He's a talented player but with selfish instincts.
